sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed with recent sales dominating and no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: VIX at crisis levels (384.0) combined with earnings binary event in 3 days creates extreme near-term risk; yield curve normal but macro backdrop severely deteriorated.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate bullish structure (three white soldiers, RSI rising, OBV bullish, price above 200-EMA) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis) offers asymmetric risk/reward for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 3 days combined with VIX crisis levels (384.0), weak trend strength (ADX 21.89), no short-term MA confirmation, Ichimoku cloud resistance, and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable execution risk that outweighs technical setup.
